premise: Ladybug thinks only Butterfly can fly, until she lifts her red back and finds her own wings folded underneath.
inspiration: The Ugly Duckling (Andersen), turned: no long winter of waiting, just a friend's question, and what she wished for was hers all along.
lesson: Sometimes what you wish for is already yours; you only have to look.
learning: A ladybug's thin flying wings fold away under her red spotted wing cases

en-US.title: Ladybug Finds Her Wings
en-US.text: {butterfly:enter} {butterfly:float loop 0.4} Butterfly came fluttering over the meadow, light as a petal. She {butterfly:live} slowly folded her wings together, rested… then opened them wide and fluttered on. Down in the grass, {ladybug:enter} Ladybug {ladybug:face sad} watched. [sad] I wish I could fly, she sighed. But my back is just round and red and spotty. {caterpillar:enter} Caterpillar came crawling by, one hump at a time. She {caterpillar:live hold} reared up tall and gazed at the sky. Me too, one day, she said dreamily. [curious] But have you ever looked under your back? Then she {caterpillar:live resume} lowered herself and gave a happy wiggle. [slowly] So Ladybug tried. {ladybug:live hold} She lifted her red spotty back like two little doors, and underneath were two thin wings, spread wide! {caterpillar:face surprised} [gasps] Wings! cried {caterpillar:sparkle} Caterpillar. Ladybug {ladybug:live resume} fluttered them, {sfx:flutter} flutter, flutter, folded them away… and took a bow. {ladybug:face happy} [happily] Then she flew {ladybug:float} to the big yellow {flower:enter} {flower:face happy} flower and back, just to be sure.

es-ES.title: Mariquita encuentra sus alas
es-ES.text: {butterfly:enter} {butterfly:float loop 0.4} Mariposa llegó revoloteando sobre el prado, ligera como un pétalo. {butterfly:live} Juntó despacio las alas, descansó… y luego las abrió de par en par y siguió volando. Entre la hierba, {ladybug:enter} Mariquita {ladybug:face sad} la miraba. [sad] Ojalá yo pudiera volar, suspiró. Pero mi espalda solo es redonda, roja y con lunares. {caterpillar:enter} Oruga llegó arrastrándose, joroba a joroba. {caterpillar:live hold} Se estiró muy alta y miró al cielo. Yo también volaré algún día, dijo, soñadora. [curious] Pero ¿has mirado alguna vez debajo de tu espalda? Luego {caterpillar:live resume} bajó despacito y se meneó contenta. [slowly] Así que Mariquita lo intentó. {ladybug:live hold} Levantó su espalda roja con lunares, como dos puertecitas, y debajo ¡había dos alas finas, bien abiertas! {caterpillar:face surprised} [gasps] ¡Alas!, gritó {caterpillar:sparkle} Oruga. Mariquita {ladybug:live resume} las agitó, {sfx:flutter} fru, fru, las guardó… e hizo una reverencia. {ladybug:face happy} [happily] Luego voló {ladybug:float} hasta la gran {flower:enter} {flower:face happy} flor amarilla y volvió, solo para estar segura.
